name: github_pr
title: GitHub PRs
description: Each open pull request you opened or whose review is requested from you is a conversation; its comments, reviews, pushes and checks are the messages.

permission.github.pull_requests.read.why: Reads the pull requests you opened or that await your review, with their comments, reviews, pushes and checks.

permission.github.pull_requests.comment.why: Posts your replies as comments on those pull requests.

filter.label: Start a conversation when a PR is
filter.hint: mine (opened by you or awaiting your review — the default), assigned (assigned to you) or review_requested (your review is requested).

repos.label: Repositories
repos.hint: owner/repo per line; empty = every repository you can reach
